episodes.title: How I got out of a cult at 16 | PART THREE
episodes.description:
At 16 years old, I left the polygamous cult I had been raised in.

Part 3 finishes off explaining how i ecwntially got out of the foster home and back into the home living witb the family who took me in when I first left.
